description: 后翼弃兵 D53 — 象对弱色格的控制

intro.popup_en: Bishops and Weak Squares, Lesson 2: A bishop is a long-range sniper, applying pressure along a diagonal without approaching the target. White's bishop on h4 controls light squares, while Black's bishop on b7 targets White's position. The better-placed bishop controls more weaknesses.
intro.popup:
象对弱色格的控制 第2课

象是远程狙击手—
不需要靠近，沿对角线长期施压

Bh4守护白格，Bb7射向白方阵地
谁的象更好，谁控制更多弱格！

outro.popup_en: White keeps the bishop on h4 to control light squares, while Black's bishop on b7 controls the long diagonal. After dxc5, the d5-square loses its black pawn defender. A bishop's color determines which color complex it can control.
outro.popup:
象的弱格控制小结
✅ Bh4守护白格，不轻易兑换
✅ Bb7黑格象控制长对角线
✅ dxc5后d5格失去黑兵守护

核心原则：
象的颜色 = 它能控制的弱格颜色

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center.
moves.popup: d4控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's move and creates a solid queenside pawn structure.
moves.popup:
d5对称防守
坚固的后翼兵型

moves.popup_en: c4 expands on the queenside and begins the Queen's Gambit.
moves.popup:
c4翼侧扩张
后翼弃兵变例开始

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces d5 and prepares minor-piece development.
moves.popup:
e6稳固d5
准备轻子发展

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nc3发展马

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展马
准备入城

moves.popup_en: Bg5! The key move of the D53 setup pins Nf6 and prepares to pressure d5 after cxd5.
moves.popup:
Bg5！D53变例核心
牵制Nf6，准备cxd5后压d5

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 remains flexible. Black does not chase the bishop with ...h6 yet.
moves.popup:
Be7灵活
不用h6赶象，保留弹性

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces White's center.
moves.popup: e3加强中心

moves.popup_en: ...O-O castles first and secures Black's king.
moves.popup:
O-O率先入城
王安全

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf3发展马

moves.popup_en: ...h6 questions the bishop and asks White to clarify its intention.
moves.popup:
h6试探白象
逼白象表态

moves.popup_en: Bh4! White preserves the bishop instead of exchanging it for Nf6. The bishop continues to control the weak light squares along the d8-h4 diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bh4！保留象
不与Nf6兑换
这个象守护d8-h4对角线弱格

moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares ...Bb7 and Black's dark-squared bishop plan.
moves.popup:
b6准备Bb7
黑方建立黑格象计划

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops and targets h7.
moves.popup:
Bd3发展象
瞄准h7

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7! Black's dark-squared bishop controls the long diagonal toward g2, demonstrating how a bishop can pressure weak squares from afar.
moves.popup:
Bb7建立长斜线！
黑格象沿b7-g2方向施压
这就是象控制弱格的威力

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king.
moves.popup: O-O白方入城

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops the other knight and prepares ...c5.
moves.popup:
Nbd7发展重马
准备c5冲击

moves.popup_en: Qe2 coordinates the center and connects the rooks.
moves.popup:
Qe2中心协调
连接双车

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black challenges d4. If White captures with dxc5, the d5-square may become weak.
moves.popup:
c5冲击！
黑方挑战d4中心
若dxc5→d5弱格暴露

moves.popup_en: Rfd1! The rook supports d4 and prepares for Black's ...c4 push, which could disrupt White's center.
moves.popup:
Rfd1！关键一步
车到d1守护d4
预防黑方c4后扰乱中心

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8 places the rook on the c-file and prepares ...c4.
moves.popup:
Rc8车到c列
准备c4冲击

moves.popup_en: dxc5 opens the position. The d5-square no longer has a black pawn defending it and may become an ideal outpost for White's knight.
moves.popup:
dxc5打开局面
此后d5格无黑兵守护
d5成为白马的绝佳弱格
